steps.name: Theodore's Call
steps.objective: Go to [Theodore] in the "Guild Union City Esnil Center".

steps.name: Heir to Zisk Plains
steps.objective: Go to [Yuran] at the "Lumen Alliance Headquarters".

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You arrived sooner than I expected. I hope I haven't interrupted your rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I shouldn't rest too long. It only gives me more time to worry...)

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I've seen you on your way to meet Dayna, but speaking with you properly feels rather extraordinary. I've never met a hero who saved the world before...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think I've earned that title yet.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Heh, why not? You can be proud of that. Surely 'hero' is a better title than the Goddess's Executioner?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Now, allow me to introduce myself properly.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: My name is Theodore. I once taught at the Imperial Academy. I'm retired now, of course...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You may already know, since you've spoken with Dayna. I taught her and her sisters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you were a tutor to the imperial...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Heh, you know quite a bit. Still, I wouldn't say too much about Dayna and her sisters.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It wouldn't do you any favors...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would it put me in danger?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: No, it would become a tremendous nuisance. As you probably know, anything involving the empire usually does.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see, Professor.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: There's no need for 'Professor.' Just call me Theo.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Theo. Please tell me why you called for me.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I've let our conversation get away from me. Have you heard of Zisk Territory in Eastland?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not much. Could you explain?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Certainly. While researching Eastland's history because of the Kingdom of Moss, I came across something interesting.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: In ancient times, when the gods fought the Demon King, a god fell to the earth and nearly destroyed Eastland itself.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Around the same time, a massive meteorite fell from the sky, bringing Eastland to the brink of annihilation.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Some power fortunately restored it, but its natural environment changed considerably. Some regions have entirely red soil; others grow strange plants...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's talking about Goddess Gaia...)

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: The meteorite may have been a curse upon Eastland, but it was also a blessing. It contained a mysterious mineral called meteoric iron.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: The power of that iron drove Eastland's civilization forward... and brought nations to glory and ruin. It laid the foundations for war and conflict, supplying weapons, magical tools, and more.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: But when House Zisk, a noble family of the Kingdom of Howl, took ownership of the impact site, they banned indiscriminate mining. The iron could only be used to make essential tools for the people and the kingdom.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Then the Deimos cult attacked Howl. The kingdom fell, and the land became the property of the Dark Holy Kingdom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since you're telling me all this, I have a feeling I'm going there.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: That's right. The heir to Zisk Territory has asked for you. He says he has something to give you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, the heir is still alive? I heard the Dark War was hundreds of years ago.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You already know him, I believe. Hmm, Zisk Territory belongs to the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos now, but I've heard the Alliance of Light can reach parts of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you mean Sir Ziskad? His name does sound like Zisk Territory...

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Well deduced. It is Sir Ziskad. I've already spoken with Dayna, so you should go and meet him.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Head to Lumen first and inquire there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll ask Yuran first. But what could the Sword Master want to give me?)

steps.name: Meeting Ziskad
steps.objective: Go to [Ziskad] at the "Zisk Plains Entrance".

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: So I'll handle Master's instructions this way, and the rest...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Every time I see her, she looks busy.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You're here. My apologies. I had so much to take care of that I didn't notice you arrive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fine. Where is Sir Ziskad? I heard he asked for me...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He was here at alliance headquarters just a moment ago...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Has he left?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He isn't here, but he'll be waiting for you. You should go to him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get to Zisk Territory? I'm not familiar with it...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Zisk Territory is near White Col Canyon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's closer than I thought!

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes. The Deimos cult had occupied it, so long ago, Master sealed the entrance with the Kingdom of Jude's help.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He wanted to keep the cult from advancing through Zisk Territory into White Col Canyon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If he's at the entrance now, does that mean the seal is gone?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Master destroyed the seal with his sword aura.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... then that means...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There appear to be no traces of the Deimos cult there now.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I don't know the details, but there seem to be no signs of the Deimos cult there at present.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The center of the continent should be the cult's domain, the Dark Holy Kingdom. Yet reports say the overall number of fanatics and other inhabitants is declining.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why would that be happening?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: We suspect it may be connected to whatever Weiss is doing.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll investigate further and let you know later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. So where exactly is the entrance?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: At the far end, through the Jewel Tree Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, there. I've passed it a few times... I'll be on my way, then.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was there something else?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Lady Iris believes in you. She is waiting for the day when she can be fully by your side.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Please take care of yourself and return safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Yuran...

steps.name: Flame of Truth
steps.objective: Defeat [Rampaging Aergia] and [Hunter Machai] in the "Zisk Plains", then report to [Jenna] in the "Zisk Plains".

lines.text: (Beyond the depths of White Col Canyon lies an unfamiliar place. An ominous feeling hangs over it, but quickly fades, perhaps dispelled by the presence of a middle-aged man.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Sir Ziskad...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Was he feeding the animals?)
(The animals in front of Ziskad scatter when the adventurer arrives.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Ah, it's you, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Sir Ziskad. I heard you called for me.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I did. Thank you for coming. A shame those little ones left before finishing their meal. I'll have to call them back later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry I frightened them away.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's all right. Ah, I owe you my thanks.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What did I...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thanks to you, one source of evil has vanished from Eastland. The Kingdom of Moss, and the false Agasuras controlling it...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You must have witnessed the end of the one called Ban. I felt his energy 'transfer' into another world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You felt that...? Lady Shynic and Lady Medea said something similar before...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Truthfully, I would rather not feel it, but as a Champion, I cannot help it.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You may already know this, but a Champion's power is part of a god's power... though I cannot say exactly which god...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's what Weiss said...)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It bears the influence of the ancient gods who once dwelled here in Eastland, in Creta...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I can only hope that no one beyond those known as the seven Champions gains this power.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: As leader of the Alliance of Light, I have a favor to ask of you. It is for Miss Iris's sake as well.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I know you will not refuse... and for that, I am truly sorry.
(A familiar black-haired girl approaches from a distance.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Master, I'm here. And %s... I haven't seen you since then.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Did you summon this person, Master?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes. I called you here because there is a task you must help our guest accomplish.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: All right. I will.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: First, Ell, show %s proper respect. This is a hero who has done much for our alliance and the continent.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: If that is your command, Master, I will obey.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can speak to me casually. Like before, the way Ull does.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Oh. Like before. The way Ull does...
(Ell's expression briefly hardens, then relaxes. It seems to say, 'How dare you compare me to Ull?')

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: No. It is my master's wish, and you have done so much for everyone. I will show you the respect you deserve.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll keep speaking to you the way I always have.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Now, let me explain what you must do here.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I would like you to search for traces of a relic. A divine relic...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A relic? I thought the gods' relics were only in Freios...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: There is much that remains unknown beyond what you know. Some things may simply be hidden from us...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: This relic is the 'Flame of Truth.' It is said to reveal the truth someone seeks when they pray before its fire.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Those who learned its truths have saved the continent more than once, and endangered it as well. Because of that risk, the Kingdom of Howl chose a sacred place to keep it.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: That place is Zisk Territory, where the Star of the Void remains... right here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Star of the Void...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: In ancient times, the battle between the gods and the Demon King shook the world. In its aftermath, a star fell here from the sky. That meteorite is called the Star of the Void...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: One tale says the sun god Agni caught hold of a star to keep from falling, only to fall with it... though I cannot vouch for that account.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: In any case, the continent nearly perished and was left with many strange climates. The area around the impact was devastated, but over time, people began to benefit from the meteorite.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The special metal it yielded, meteoric iron, advanced civilization in Eastland and the Kingdom of Howl. But the technology built upon that iron also led countless lives to their deaths.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Perhaps that was inevitable on a continent steeped in conflict.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I've gone on long enough. I would like you to find the Flame of Truth. I am certain it is somewhere in this territory...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Can you sense a suspicious power somewhere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. There's definitely something in there.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I can feel that power, but I doubt I can locate it. If I cannot, others will likely fare no better. That is why I called for you; I believe you are suited to the task.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I thought you might find it through your spiritual connection to Miss Iris, who holds the position of the God of the Astral Realm.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Please find it. With its help, we could learn what the Alliance of Light can do for Eastland...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: And you could discover the answers you seek.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The answers I seek...)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You look as though you have made up your mind. Miss Iris approved as well, hoping you would do this. Go with Ell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Iris agrees... then we'll go.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The suspicious energy seems to be at the center of the territory. Look there first. Please be careful.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: We will return, Master.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's get going...)

steps.name: Jenna the Ghost
steps.objective: Defeat [Zisk Plains Algea] and [Courier Ponos] in the "Zisk Plains", then report to [Jenna].

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: It's been so long since anyone came here. ♪

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: A few monsters, but nothing we can't handle. I mean... nothing you need worry about. Forgive me. I'm not used to this yet...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fine. You'll get used to it. But who's singing?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: They probably won't be able to see me either. ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, who are you?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: What? As you know, I'm Ell...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Huh? You can see me? You can hear my voice?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I can see you, so that's what I'm saying. If you're asking how I can see you...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Who are you talking to...? Oh, come on. Don't tell me there's a ghost here!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you can't see her, Ell? The girl standing right here...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'm sorry! Whatever I did, I'm sorry, so please stop! Waaah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So there is something you're afraid of. Her feet look a little hazy, just like a ghost's...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Hehe, you're rather mischievous.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: S-stop! I'll rest over there for a while. Call me when you're done chatting with the g-ghost.
(Ell tries to look composed, but backs away with fear written faintly across her face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I wasn't trying to tease her... Anyway, who are you?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I should have introduced myself. I'm Jenna. Jenna Zisk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna. That's a lovely name. It's nice to meet you. I'm %s. You can just call me that.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s... What a nice name.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm so glad to meet someone here who can see me... Someone who can listen to my story...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: People pass through sometimes, but they never see me. They always walk right by... You don't seem troubled by seeing me. Or even surprised...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I've had a few unusual experiences...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, wait. Zisk? Zisk? They told me this was Zisk Territory. Then that means...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That's right. My father was the lord of this land. As his daughter, people used to address me as a young lady of the house.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My older brother is the man the world calls the Sword Master. He loves animals.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then... I'd better explain why I'm here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer briefly explains the reason for coming.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: So you can see me because you're the goddess's messenger. And you came here at my brother's request...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Excuse me, %s... Sorry to interrupt, but monsters seem to be heading this way. We should deal with them.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Oh, shall we talk afterward? Go ahead. Don't worry about me. No one can hurt me.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Please be careful. There's something I'd like to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: ...U-ugh... Let's hurry... Ugh... But where is the ghost?

steps.name: Jenna's Gift
steps.objective: Defeat monsters in the "Zisk Plains" to obtain <Zisk Chrysanthemums>. Then report to [Ziskad].

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm glad you weren't hurt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'll just listen to your conversation for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Ell. The ghost... I mean, Jenna, seems a little disappointed, though...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ugh... She really is there, right? Please, don't mind me. Just talk with %s.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Of course. Thank you. Then, Adventurer, may I begin?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I've been waiting here for a long time for someone who could see me.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I don't know exactly how long. Four hundred years, and who knows how much longer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's such a long time...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I heard there was a great war on the continent. Or perhaps I should say I somehow came to know it.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: A war the Deimos cult started to seize control of the continent... To establish a foothold for that war, they attacked our territory first.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: We thought Howl and Zisk Territory were holding them off fairly well, but everything collapsed in an instant.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The fanatics killed every living thing they saw. My brother and I tried desperately to escape, but...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Just before we could make it out through White Col Canyon...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: This is what became of me, but I'm glad my brother survived. And that he's working for everyone's sake...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does Sir Ziskad know what's happened to you?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: He came near here after the entrance was unsealed recently, but he doesn't seem able to sense my ghost.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: He can't come in here, and I can't reach the entrance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: You seem to be the only person who can see me. Even when the fanatics come in from the north, they just pass by.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I wondered why there were fanatics here. White Col Canyon isn't the only entrance, then. There's one on the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos's side.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That's right. I don't know why I woke up as a ghost, still remembering the moment I died.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: And I can't leave the territory. There must be a reason, don't you think?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. I should tell Sir Ziskad first... Maybe he can find a way to learn why.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Being unable to leave the territory... It's like when I met Minuet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He should be nearby. I'll go and come right back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. He's your brother, after all. And I don't think it's a coincidence that I can see you.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Could you pick a flower that grows here and give it to my brother? A white chrysanthemum.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I'll be back. Ell, wait here a moment.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes. What?! What?! Y-yes?! Please don't leave me alone...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ahaha... Please don't be so frightened. Maybe I could sing you a cheerful song...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I was a little surprised when I sensed you coming back...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Well, tell me. What happened in the center of the territory?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if you'll believe me, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer explains meeting the ghost of Jenna, Ziskad's younger sister, in the territory.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: What did you just say? Jenna? Jenna is there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And she asked me to pick this and give it to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer gives Ziskad the flower, as Jenna requested.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Jenna... Jenna remembered this flower... They used to grow everywhere in our land, but now they're so hard to find...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: She loved ornaments made from these flowers...
(Ziskad's eyes tremble visibly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir Ziskad...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes. Everything you said is true. I tried to escape the Deimos cult together with my sister Jenna.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Our parents said it was their duty as lords to defend the territory, and sent the two of us away.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I brought Jenna this far, believing everything would be all right. I had faith in my sword. But...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I thought I could protect Jenna. I truly believed it. But it was all arrogance, born of treating the sword too lightly.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The fanatics attacked, and Jenna fell bleeding. And I... I could do nothing...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Forgive me. I let my emotions get the better of me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I shouldn't have brought...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: No. Memories I had pushed aside came back so suddenly... I am the one who should apologize.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I buried Jenna here. Then, unable to master my thirst for vengeance, I began hunting down and cutting down the cult's fanatics.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: People knew nothing of that. They followed me, simply hoping for a brighter future for our continent. When they called me a Sword Saint, it struck me like a blow.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: ...I realized I was wrong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, does he mean the people of the Alliance of Light?)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I realized I had to use my sword rightly again. For them, for the continent... and for Jenna, my family, and every life that had been taken.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I've dwelled on the past long enough. Forgive me. But I don't know why... why Jenna's ghost is visible only to you.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It is as though something is influencing her...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: If we find the relic, we must use a chance to learn the truth... though I don't know how many chances it will grant...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. What should I tell Jenna?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Tell her we may learn the answer if we find the relic... I would like to go inside myself, but... I cannot...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is that so...? Then Ell and I will keep searching for the relic.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you. For not asking further...

steps.name: A Suspicious Place
steps.objective: Go to [Ell] in front of the "Star of the Void" in the "Zisk Plains".

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: When will you come, where might you be? The hours pass as I wait for you. ♬

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: ...U-ugh... There's something so eerie nearby... It's almost as if a ghost were singing.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: ...Actually, Ell, that's exactly what's happening.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: %s, you're back. I've been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm back. Sorry, Ell. I left you alone for too long.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It's all right. I'll take a quick look around, so please talk. I won't be long.
(Ell hurries away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That wait must have been hard on her. Oh, Jenna. I've spoken with Sir Ziskad.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: What did my brother say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, he said...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer relays the conversation with Ziskad to Jenna.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I see. I'll help however I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know about something called the Flame of Truth?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Not much, but my parents told me a little about what it is. I don't know where it is, though.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I do have one idea: the Star of the Void over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Star of the Void...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The people revered the meteorite, saying its star energy blessed them. I sometimes went there to pray, too.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Its meteoric iron brought prosperity to everyone. After the Deimos cult occupied this place, all the iron they mined was shipped somewhere else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What could the cult possibly want it for...?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: ...You should try looking there. The Star of the Void is at the far end of Zisk Territory.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was already sensing some kind of power lingering there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn't feel like the menace of Weiss, or energy from the Demon Realm...)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: %s, there's a place we need to investigate. Suspicious beings and monsters are gathering there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it in the direction of that meteorite?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes. The beings emerging from there seem to be filling Zisk Territory...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We should go there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Please find the answers you're looking for.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: ...So she's still there...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes. I'm right beside you, Ell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, should I tell Ell that...?)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Let's go, %s. We'll get closer and assess the situation before making our move.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

steps.name: The Serpent's Shadow
steps.objective: Defeat the [The Serpent's Shadow] in the "Star of the Void", then report to [Ell] in the "Zisk Plains".

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: This vile energy... It isn't the Deimos cult's energy that I know. No, it's as though something else is mixed into it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel it too. There's definitely something inside the meteorite.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Dealing with all these strange creatures before going inside would take too long.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: So while I cut down the creatures coming out, %s, please go inside and investigate the ominous energy or any trace of the relic yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure I should go?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Master has acknowledged you, %s. And you can do things I cannot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that mean you've acknowledged me, too?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I simply respect talent, whatever its form.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: As long as you don't tease me about being afraid of... ghosts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never teased you. Hehe...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Now, let's hurry. That's enough chatting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be on my way.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes. I'll get moving too.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: So this is Master's homeland...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: For the master who took in my brother and me, I'll see this task through perfectly before I return.
(A suspicious energy emanates from the deepest reaches of the Star of the Void.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where am I?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wandered all the way inside, but that thing over there...
(A serpent-shaped being filled with strange energy stares intently.)
You did well to find me. I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is that? A snake? No, it doesn't seem like an ordinary snake. And it's speaking...
Suddenly, I remember something he once said to someone like you.
That you would be a great obstacle to his work! That he would regret not disposing of you then and there!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about? Who are you?
I may not be him, but I am his shadow... Me? Call me the Serpent's Shadow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A serpent? The Serpent's Shadow? What's that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You look utterly lost. Then let me explain.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: If another person with a soul like yours had come instead, they would surely understand these words.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A sudden chill runs through the adventurer at the Serpent's Shadow's words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A soul like mine? What does that mean? But...

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You may not understand, but you feel it instinctively.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: I'll show you who my true self is, and what his will means.
(The Serpent's Shadow suddenly smacks its lips.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what are you doing?

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Now that I have awakened, I cannot defy his will. So I'll swallow you whole.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: My task is to destroy you, an obstacle to his will.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: But with the power you possess, perhaps I could escape his will myself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shut up. Every last one of you goes on about power, power, power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you want power so badly, I'll give you a proper fight. I don't know who 'he' is, but I'll break that will of his.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You seek the truth. If you cannot bear it, being swallowed would be the wiser choice.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Not wanting it will not stop that will from being set in motion. I desire it, and so does he...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll make you regret those words. I'm stopping this 'will' right here and now.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: If you can.
(The instant it finishes speaking, the Serpent's Shadow opens its jaws wide, baring enormous fangs.)

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: G-graaagh...

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Impossible... His will, overcome by a mere human...

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Even if I am only a shadow...
(The Serpent's Shadow slows. Its form gradually begins to fade.)

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: He will no longer permit me to exist...

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: ...So this is how I disappear.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: After living so long to uphold his will, all because a human bested me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems this person you keep mentioning doesn't think much of you.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Perhaps your will surpassed his for a moment... Yes, you were never an ordinary human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe. I've been through far too much to call myself ordinary anymore.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: That is not what I mean...

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: You truly know nothing of yourself. Though it does suit a human to walk toward oblivion without ever learning the truth...

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: The one who rose from human to god also knows far too little. If you wish to know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean? Tell me!

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Have her look where I vanish and witness the truth unknown to a god. She will give you the wisest answer.

lines.speaker: 뱀 그림자
lines.text: Ouroboros. How can you leave me like this... like...
(The Serpent's Shadow vanishes without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I... I didn't even get a proper answer. What on earth is going on...?
(An apparition of Iris appears before %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry to appear so suddenly...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The Serpent's Shadow said to look where it disappeared...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That must be there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... Can you see something?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It seems to be something only I can see. Something visible only to my eyes...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Let me take a look, and I'll tell you.
(Iris's apparition stares at the spot where the Serpent's Shadow vanished.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Unordered memories of an unfamiliar place suddenly rise to the surface.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What Iris is seeing... I'm seeing it too...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Who is that?
(The image of another woman suddenly appears.)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: I am Nii. Guardian of Luminous City...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I saw her at Yggdrasil, but she seems different. Is she another being?)

lines.speaker: 니이
lines.text: The people of Luminous City do not yet know of its existence, but soon Luminous, too, will become part of these worlds.

lines.speaker: 오딘
lines.text: As long as we remain here to prevent this world's collapse, you are the only one who can pursue Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...That isn't the Odin I met, either...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It sounds as though they're speaking to me. But I have no memory of them... They're talking to someone else, so why does it sound like this?)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: This isn't the time for that. The child Ouroboros captured...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who is this girl...?)
Beyond time, into a world of the past... My beloved child of destiny...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A strange pain... Ugh... That person looks like the Emperor of Jiendia I saw at the Dragon Emperor's Castle...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You are...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A woman in the vision Iris and the adventurer are watching seems to meet their eyes. Surely... it must be imagination?)
You are looking at me now, Iris.
Iris... Just as you wished, a world without pain or sorrow was created.
You, whom Lady Seres loves... This place, born from your will, is so full of happiness.
But Ouroboros misunderstood your wish and awoke. It is trying to make a world where nothing exists at all.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I knew, but...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It was because of me. I... I...
Iris, it isn't your fault. The fault lies with those who torment you.
Those who are trying to devour your world now...
Just as Odin and Nii have protected it from long ago until today, both you and %s can do it.
It is not your fault. You, who will become a great god...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, who are you...?
We will meet someday. First, please help Iris.
(With those words, the figures before them gradually fade.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, are you all right? None of this is your fault.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The being that awoke in the world I created... Ouroboros...
(Iris appears to be in shock.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Iris? Iris, are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Iris?
(Iris freezes motionless, then suddenly disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Where did you go? Ah... What's this feeling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Everything in sight suddenly distorts. A black rift opens and begins to swallow it all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Th-this is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The sight of Ban disappearing in Moros suddenly flashes through the adventurer's mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-no! I have to get out of here!

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: The monsters disappeared, like illusions...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: What on earth happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah, hah... I barely got out.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: %s, are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ell, I'm fine. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'm fine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew... Let me catch my breath, and I'll explain. What happened was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer briefly tells Ell what happened inside the Star of the Void.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: ...I see. What could that being have been, and why was it here...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know either. All I know is that it was called Ouroboros...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: That being must be why the monsters, demons, and other enemies emerging from the Star of the Void vanished like illusions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go back to Jenna for now. We didn't learn anything here, but she might know something.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Then let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is happening...?)

steps.name: Oblivion and Truth (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Lethe of Oblivion] at the "Lake of Oblivion" and obtain the <Flame of Truth>. Then report to [Jenna] in the "Zisk Plains".

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The wind passes you and me, whispering to wipe away our falling tears. ♪

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I just can't remember the next part. How did it go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That was a lovely song, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you. I'm not very good, but I like humming to myself.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: The g-ghost was singing, then. Somehow, I almost feel as if I can hear her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Since you've come back to me, I suppose you didn't find the Flame of Truth.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Is there anywhere else we could look?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Somewhere else... Adventurer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Do you feel something right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure... Oh, do you mean Iris?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Iris...? Ah, the person who became a god, whom you told me about when you arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Iris. But she isn't here. She came briefly and disappeared. It's complicated...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Then what I sensed was...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Could there be another godlike being here...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No sooner has Jenna spoken than a chill settles over the area.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: ...Excuse me. Who are you?
(At Jenna's question, the air grows cold. Ell, who was moving a moment ago, begins to freeze in place.)
You found me. I only approached because I wanted to hear your conversation.
(A woman's voice comes from somewhere nearby.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She knows me... This feels sacred, like when I met Lady Gaia... But it's different. Slightly corrupted...)
Would you consider leaving empty-handed?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And if I won't?
Hehe. Then shall we talk for a moment?
(The moment she finishes speaking, the world is filled with an ominous presence.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Where are we...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels like that place someone once dragged me into against my will...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But it looks as though Zisk Territory has simply grown dark.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Show yourself now.

choices.text: 1. You said you wanted to talk.

lines.text: How bold.
(A blazing red flame rises from the darkness, and a woman appears.)
I had hoped no one would come this far.
(Red flames burn at the woman's fingertips.)
But you came here. And you disturbed his shadow...
(Blue flames flare in her other hand. Two flames, each a different color...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could that be...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you trying to say? Who are you?
I am Lethe.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Those who feared my power barred me from Etoile. Yet now they are gone.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: They said they needed my power, so I merely showed it to them. And they banished me from this world I love...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Beings destined only to perish, yet so afraid of the truth...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: You bear the blessings of the children who stood with them.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Children who love humans so dearly...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Poor Seres, whom they used, and Gaia, whom they abandoned...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you're a god.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: God... A name given by living beings to those with power whom they followed. Nothing more.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I will say it once more. Leave now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If your power is truth, then let us learn the truth for the sake of this world you love.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I believe you are the first human to ask me.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: You there, girl. You know what I am, too. And what you wish to ask of a great being such as myself...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Why am I here? I know I died...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Girl and adventurer, are you certain you can bear the truth?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to know. For everyone's sake... and for Iris.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: 'For everyone's sake' is one of humanity's most certain lies... A descendant of the humans Seres created, a girl who has yet to become a true god...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I wonder whether you can learn the truth without rejecting it. Gods and humans alike want nothing but power. They refuse to accept the truth!
(Lethe's voice grows heated. In the distance, the waters along the lakeshore churn into a violent whirlpool.)

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: He... He brought me here, and I will show you exactly what that means!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...This isn't the feeling of a god. It's... the opposite... Could she be one of the Twisted?)

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Ah. I became a little agitated.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I wished for no one to come. But since your god has led you here, you had better be prepared.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: If you are ready to learn the truth, come and kill me. I will be waiting at the Lake of Oblivion.
(The darkened Zisk Territory returns to its original appearance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth was that...?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: %s, I've been looking everywhere. Where did you go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ell, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Ell about meeting the being called Lethe.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It's hard to believe... but you experienced it yourself...
(Ell stares at the lakeshore.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: She did tell you to come if you wanted the truth...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Then what we're looking for must be there. Probably what she was holding...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: ...Ready to learn the truth...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ah! You there...?!

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: You can see me? Then that means...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It must be Lethe's influence. Since you can see Jenna now, too...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: That's a relief. At least now I can see you...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Come to think of it, you do look a little like Master...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I am his only sister, after all.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: But even if I can see you, you're still a ghost... Eek! You have no legs! No legs!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... I think it's time I went.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Please be careful.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'll come with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please wait here, Ell. I'm the only one Lethe is expecting.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: All right. If it's you, Adventurer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then please protect Jenna here. I'm counting on you, Ell.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Of course. May fortune favor you in battle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Please take care.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ell.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Yes? I still can't get used to this. Talking to someone who has died...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Just think of it as talking to an ordinary ghost.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: (As Master's sister, she's certainly extraordinary...)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: What is the truth, exactly? Is it all right for me to know it?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: There's a saying: a lie is like a coin with two sides. Dig a little deeper and turn it over, and the other side will appear. That side is the truth.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That's a lovely saying.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It is.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: (My brother taught it to me...)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: There's something unsettling about this place. As though enemies might attack at any moment...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Don't worry. I'll cut down every enemy who stands in my master's or the adventurer's way.
(At the far end of the lakeshore path, Lethe is nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Lethe?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, over there... I think someone's there...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I'd finally found a trace of the serpent! And some idiot woman who thinks she's a god ruined it!

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I have no idea what you're talking about. Beast wearing a human's form...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Gods only ever see what suits them. They don't even consider looking at anything else.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Just as I thought. Perhaps the reason you were able to come here...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Urgh, that old man... What has he done this time...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: If the old man had a hand in this, you must know too. What humans call gods might actually be...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Enough tedious talk. Shall we find out just how much a god can do?

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Wait...
(Lethe falters, seemingly sensing something dangerous.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Someone who thinks herself a god may find this laughable. But this...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Isn't everything a foolish god like you knows.
(As Kazno finishes speaking, the flames in Lethe's hands flicker and shrink.)

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: M-my flames... H-how...? U-ugh...
(Kazno sneers as Lethe suffers at the sight of her fading flames.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I could destroy everything you treasure right here. If I use this power... Ugh.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Urgh... Damn it, here of all places... Cough, cough.
(Kazno collapses to the ground and returns to his original form.)

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: You are not whole...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Damn it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop!

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: An intruder...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to meet you as promised, Lethe. But... Kazno? Why are you here?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Damn it... I never thought I'd be caught here. Cough, cough... Don't concern yourself. I have my own work to...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kazno? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Hah... hah... Damn it!
(A boy wearing a hat slowly walks out from behind Kazno.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno, you idiot! I told you I wouldn't let you off if you pushed your body too hard!

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: So that damned old man has meddled with someone else.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: You underestimate me. However long I was unable to return here...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I may be on the same level as the beings you know as gods.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Ridiculous. You think I'm afraid of some foolish god?
(At Jeril's words, the still waters of the lakeshore surge violently.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...What incredible power.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I could deal with you in Kazno's place, but this isn't my moment in the spotlight. I'll step aside.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I'm leaving this to you, %s...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I'll take Kazno away. You see to it that this foolish god's little party ends properly.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The leaders of the sinners have already had a hand in things. You, beloved by three goddesses, should find her easy enough to handle.
(Jeril scoops Kazno into his arms.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Wh-what are you doing?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno, ever heard of a princess carry? A shame you're Kazno instead of a lovely princess.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: %s, see if you can give this place a happy ending.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: H-hey...
(With a faint smile, Jeril vanishes without a trace, taking Kazno with him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Focus. I have to defeat the being in front of me.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: ...It will not be so simple. Come closer. Approach the Flame of Truth that will burn you...
(Lethe sinks to the ground, and the flames slip from her hands onto the earth.)

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: ...Impossible...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: My flames...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: H-hot... They burn my hands...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems even a former god made some kind of bargain to achieve something...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth...
(Lethe repeatedly tries to cradle the flames, but their heat makes her drop them each time.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the Flame of Truth...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It isn't hot at all. But this...
(As %s reaches out, the Flame of Truth plunges into the adventurer's chest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! What's...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: ...So this was the truth I refused to see.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: The same ending as those I hated and despised...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: So this is why I was reunited with the flames. To rebuke me for my wrong choice...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Human... No, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Lethe...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: I told you. If you wanted the truth, you were to come and kill me.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Kill me. Then you may learn one truth you have longed to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I won't kill you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All I need is the Flame of Truth. I only want to use the truth to stop evil.
(Lethe stares in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: You are different from the others. Perhaps I misunderstood humans...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Yes. You are the one Seres and Gaia chose...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Then I will tell you one thing you wish to know. Something concerning you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm curious about you, but that isn't what matters right now. If it's a truth about me... it won't mean I have to kill you, will it?

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Nothing of the sort. Do not doubt me. Accept it freely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Only one thing?
(Lethe nods.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then... why did I lose my memories?

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: You lost your memories because the child who became a new god was trying to protect you.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: So do not resent her. It would grieve Seres...
(As soon as Lethe finishes speaking, her form begins to fade.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lethe...

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Only those with special power may learn a truth, once each. Please treasure my flames.

lines.speaker: 레테
lines.text: Do not worry. I am merely returning to where I was before. A place that may be truth, or may be oblivion...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lethe's gone.
(The Flame of Truth remains in %s's hand in the form of a tiny jewel.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Were my memories really the only thing I wanted to know about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For now, let's return to Ell and Jenna.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: What a relief. Nothing happened to you, did it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine... I'll tell you what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer briefly explains the events at the lakeshore.)
(Ell and Jenna seem to understand after hearing the story. Then Ell notices a man standing nearby.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Wait. Who are you?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: What a beautiful young lady. Lovely enough that I'd like to call you a princess...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Th-thank you. But how can you see me?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hehe. I have special eyes. You there, %s. Remember me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your name was Jeril, wasn't it...?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: At least you remember my name properly. Kazno should have come, but he's in no condition to do so. I came instead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were definitely...
(Jeril steps close to %s.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That's far enough...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Don't talk about me. Unless you want...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Never mind that. Kazno had a message for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I don't know what truth you want to learn, but there won't be one that's good for everyone.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: And you, Adventurer, will be the one who makes that choice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell him I already know that much.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: He also said he'll keep pursuing the serpent. As for me... I'm looking for a way to stop what another sinner is doing for Azrael...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Azrael?!

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Yes, Azrael. Ask that sinner for the details when you meet. I can't tell you yet, either.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: We'll meet again when the time comes, when the end comes. Until then, take care. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Oh, Lethe already told you one truth. If there's something else you want to know, you'd better use what you're holding.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The moment you leave this territory, you'll lose that right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My right? And what do you mean, we'll meet at the end...?
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Jeril heads off and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's exactly what Weiss said. What is this 'end'...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But if I lose it when I leave... how do I find out what I want to know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lethe already told me about myself...)
(The adventurer suddenly meets Ell and Jenna's eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Don't worry about me. There are truths I need, but I can uncover them myself.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Who was that person, anyway? No, that isn't important right now. And more than me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna... There was something you wanted to know, wasn't there? Why you kept the memories of your death.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Is that all right? Using it for me now...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure it will be.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do I do it?
(As %s wonders, a clear apparition of Iris appears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You don't need to worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, are you all right? Earlier...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm fine. If anything, it comforted me. But that isn't what I came to say.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's nice to meet you, Jenna.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: You can see me? Ah, you aren't an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm Iris. Your brother has been helping me. Would you come closer?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes.
(As Jenna approaches Iris, the atmosphere of Zisk Territory suddenly changes.)

steps.name: Oblivion and Truth (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Jenna] in the "Zisk Plains", then find [Ziskad] at the "Zisk Plains Entrance".

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: This is like the place we were in when Lethe appeared. Though it feels different. Then you must be...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hehe. Just what you're thinking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reverse side...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's right, %s. A place that exists, yet does not exist.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do we do now? To learn what Jenna wants to know.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Speak to the Flame of Truth in your hand. Then say the name of the person who needs the truth.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um... There's something I want to know. Jenna. I want to know the truth about Jenna.
(The adventurer speaks to the Flame of Truth, but it does not respond.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Oh, I think it will only respond after I leave. Don't worry too much. These flames only react to those who possess divine power.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll see you again in a little while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: O-okay.
(When Iris disappears, blue and red flames rise from the jewel, mingling together.)
(Jenna's face is tense with anticipation.)
(The flames grow larger, then begin to show Jenna and %s what appears to be a memory of a place.)
(An attacking force, a burning village, and a crumbling castle come into view. People's screams mingle in a chorus of agony.)

lines.speaker: 청년
lines.text: Father! Father! I can't just leave!

lines.speaker: 중년 남성
lines.text: Kaien! At least you must get Jenna out of here! As a noble of the Kingdom of Howl and lord of this land, it is my duty to defend it.

lines.speaker: 카이엔
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: 중년 남성
lines.text: I do not regret this choice. I will do everything I can to protect His Majesty's people.

lines.speaker: 중년 남성
lines.text: Go! Kaien!
(Someone watches the scene from afar.)

lines.speaker: 수상한 남자
lines.text: I knew there were many who wished for this world's destruction. I came here as a sinner, but finding a witch like you is a surprise.

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: Shh. That's enough.

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: I will do my part, and you need only do what you can.

lines.speaker: 수상한 남자
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: Weiss... I must see the lord.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Very well. I'll return, then. Handle things here yourself.

lines.speaker: 여인
lines.text: My lord... It has been a long time.

lines.speaker: 중년 남성
lines.text: Daphne? How could you do this to me?!

lines.speaker: 중년 남성
lines.text: Ungrateful wretch! I only helped your people so that neither the Deimos cult nor the kingdom would make them suffer... Why must we...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I am grateful for the help you gave our people, my lord. But your kingdom did something it never should have done.

lines.speaker: 중년 남성
lines.text: ...What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: My lord... Even if I told you, you would soon forget.

lines.speaker: 카이엔
lines.text: Daphne! What are you thinking?!

lines.speaker: 중년 남성
lines.text: N-no! Daphne, stop... Stop, stop! Stop it! Kaien, Jenna! Run!

lines.speaker: 중년 남성
lines.text: You witch! I will curse you to the end, even in death! I should never... never have let you... near us...

lines.speaker: 카이엔
lines.text: Father! Father!

lines.speaker: 카이엔
lines.text: Jenna!

lines.speaker: 카이엔
lines.text: Father...?

lines.speaker: 카이엔
lines.text: Jenna... Jenna...

lines.speaker: 카이엔
lines.text: Father, Jenna... Where did you go?

lines.speaker: 카이엔
lines.text: Daphne... Daphne... You witch!
(Nothing more can be seen.)
(The darkness slowly lifts, revealing Jenna's sorrowful face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: So that's what happened. That heavy feeling is finally gone...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I didn't die. I was erased.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: And the being here who thinks of herself as Jenna is a thought-form, created from my brother's grief...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: ...What do you mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ell, what happened was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Ell what just happened.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: ...Lady Jenna and Master's past, revealed by the Flame of Truth. I will keep this to myself.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you, Ell. And you, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Jenna?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Even if I'm a being made of 'memories,' that's all right. Though I would have liked to be real.
(Jenna smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I only exist like this because my brother never forgot this place all these years... I can only be grateful.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s, please go back now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: You've found the Flame of Truth and uncovered my truth... There is nothing more for you to do here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna, are you sure you're all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris! Iris! Where are you? Can you hear me?
(At %s's cry, Iris's apparition appears before them. Ell seems unable to see her and looks completely puzzled.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The Flame of Truth has the power to reveal the truth. But in exchange...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My memories are true, but my existence isn't. I think I'll disappear soon.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh no...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there really nothing we can do, Iris...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: %s, would you please head back first?
(Iris lowers her head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A small smile spreads across Iris's face. Ell and Jenna do not seem to notice.)
(When the adventurer looks up again, Iris is gone.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Is Lady Iris here right now? And Lady Jenna...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna, we'll be going now... It was lovely meeting you.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s, Ell. Thank you both. I'll never forget you.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: We'll be on our way, then...
(Jenna forces a smile as she sees them off. She keeps waving until they are no longer visible in Zisk Territory.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: The wind brushes past you and me, whispering to wipe away our falling tears. ♪

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: O goddess of the earth, hold fast the passing wind. ♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Now I remember the next part. That must be my brother's memory, too.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: ...My body is growing fainter...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Then, goodbye...
(Jenna closes her eyes and waits for the moment to come.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I can feel the wind...
(Jenna looks ahead and sees a woman standing before her.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Poor child...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Who are you...?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: How fortunate that you have not yet fallen asleep.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ah, you are...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Yes. I am Gaia... A memory restored by the Flame of Truth has been a great help to everyone.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: So I would like to give you a gift. Will you remain here?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes?
(Gaia smiles gently.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Now that Jenna Zisk's spirit and memories are one, I grant you leave to remain in this place.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: May painful memories trouble you no longer...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Master is over there. Please wait here a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Ell.
(Ziskad's back is visible in the distance. He seems to stand still, but his shoulders tremble faintly.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It's all right. Come over.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: We've returned, Master.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Well done, Ell. And you too, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing. And here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer hands Ziskad the Flame of Truth in its jewel form. There seems to be no need to explain how to use it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Sir Ziskad... But what happened to Jenna?)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You need not worry about Jenna.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: By a god's grace, she will not disappear. It seems she will remain in Zisk Territory...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Thank goodness! Thank... Whew...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a relief! Whew... Jenna, I'm so glad...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Master, I will leave you now. I would only interrupt your conversation, so I'll step aside.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you, Ell. I'll call for you later.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Oh, %s. Master has stopped drinking at Senior Yuran's urging. If he asks for a drink, please stop him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I will.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Now, you little...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'll be going, then.
(Ell immediately heads toward White Col Canyon, looking relieved that the task is finished.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir Ziskad... You learned it naturally again this time, didn't you?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Being a Champion really is...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I know what you're going to say. Even if I do not wish to know, I must. Unless I surrender my life.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I resisted it at first, but I am used to it now. I can think of it as proof that a god loved Eastland.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Today, unlike other days, I will rejoice wholeheartedly. I have the goddess, you, and Ell to thank...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: My guilt over failing to protect my sister must have been deep indeed. To think I lived with such distorted memories...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Daphne was the one who brought the Deimos cult to Zisk Territory... It was because of that woman...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: When the time comes, I must visit Medea. She may know something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Medea, Daphne... Come to think of it, Xerenis Magic Academy's festival was called Daphne, too...)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: What shall I say when I see Jenna...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You must be looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I'll prepare plenty of the things she loved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm happy for you.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Though she is no longer alive... that will be all right, won't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I should visit Jenna later.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: To be able to speak with my sister again... It has already been some four hundred and fifty years...
(Ziskad's expression is complicated, mingling joy at seeing his sister with sorrow for the time that has passed.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Ah, %s... I've kept you waiting. Now, turn your back to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Go on.
(The adventurer quickly turns around. A moment later, an immense light seems to wash over them.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I hope my power will help Miss Iris. Now, let us return to the matter at hand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. What truth do you wish to learn, Sir Ziskad?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Something concerning Weiss and the Deimos cult... Let me try.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Flame of Truth...
(The flames in Ziskad's hand swell and flicker. By the time they return to the form of a small jewel, his expression has twisted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir Ziskad?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It lasted only an instant, but I will tell you what I saw.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Everything Weiss has done so far was practice. Practice for one decisive act...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What act?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: It appears he means to bring the Twisted One, Deimos, down upon this land...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: While I investigate further, rest until I call for you.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Though I doubt you will simply sit idle. Haha. And I will keep the Flame of Truth somewhere safe.
(Ziskad forces a smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir Ziskad...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I am all right. Ah, I have one more request. Keep what happened here to yourself. Everyone will learn of it when the time comes, of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You've done well. I'll remain here a while before returning. Go on ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll see you later.
(Ziskad watches %s head toward White Col Canyon for a long time.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer.
(Ziskad stares at the Flame of Truth in his hand.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: May you survive to the very end in this world, and remain with everyone.
